description:
Commander Shepard starts aboard the Normandy with no squad and no leads. Recover the coordinates, rebuild the
team, and gather enough Prothean beacon fragments to reach Ilos and stop Saren.

v0.1.1.description:
Fixes the goal not being sent when you finish the game. The client was waiting for a game flag that Mass Effect LE1 never sets. It now uses the flag the game sets during Shepard's final speech before the credits, for both Council outcomes.

**Updating from 0.1.0:** only the apworld changed. Replace `mass_effect_le1.apworld` in your Archipelago `custom_worlds` folder with the one attached here and restart the Launcher. The game mod and the LE1APBridge ASI are unchanged, so you don't need to reinstall them. Existing multiworlds and YAMLs keep working.

**New players:** download `ArchipelagoME1-0.1.1.zip` and follow the [setup guide](https://github.com/Unowa001/ArchipelagoME1/blob/main/worlds/mass_effect_le1/docs/setup_en.md).

Requires Archipelago 0.6.8 or newer. Report problems in Issues with your newest ME1Client log.
v0.1.1.title: 0.1.1 (alpha)

v0.2.0.description:
Beta test of the next version. Shop slots are new and not yet confirmed in game: if they cause trouble, set `shop_slots: 0` in your YAML.

**New**
- **Shop slots**: "Archipelago Item" entries in the stock of ten merchants (Normandy, Citadel, Noveria, Feros, Virmire), a few hundred credits each. Option `shop_slots`, 0-5 per merchant, default 3. Connect the client before your first shop visit.
- **HUD notices** for items you send and receive, fragment count and Ilos opening.
- **Infinite sprint** option (on by default).
- **Travel videos skipped**: the mass relay and FTL videos on the galaxy map (choose Skip or Keep when installing the mod).

**Logic fixes**
- Uncharted planets that open through story events now have matching logic. Luna, Binthu and MSV Ontario are open from the start.
- The Citadel stays landable after Ilos opens. Asteroid X57 needs its coordinates in game too.
- Garrus and Wrex recruitment checks always send, even when their item arrived first.
- New option `finished_mission_checks`: Therum and Virmire close for good once finished, so their containers hold filler by default.

**Updating from 0.1.x:** replace the apworld, import and apply the new mod zip in ME3Tweaks Mod Manager, run `install-bridge.ps1` again (bridge v9), and start a **new career**. YAMLs from 0.1.x still work (new options use their defaults).

**Generating and hosting:** make your YAML in the Launcher's Options Creator, click Generate in the Launcher, then upload the zip from `Archipelago/output` at https://archipelago.gg/uploads to host it. See the [setup guide](https://github.com/Unowa001/ArchipelagoME1/blob/main/worlds/mass_effect_le1/docs/setup_en.md).

Requires Archipelago 0.6.8 or newer. Report problems in Issues with your newest ME1Client log.
v0.2.0.title: 0.2.0 (beta test)

v0.2.1.description:
> **Known issue: this version hangs at the main menu. Use [0.2.2](https://github.com/Unowa001/ArchipelagoME1/releases/tag/v0.2.2) instead.**

Beta test. Everything in 0.2.0 plus an **in-game tracker**. Shop slots and the tracker are not yet confirmed in game, so please report what you see.

**New: know where to go without leaving the game**
- **F7**: a summary on the HUD: checks in logic per region, the best uncharted planets, and what each locked world still needs (e.g. `Virmire [coords, Kaidan + Ashley]`, `Ilos [fragments 1/4, finish Virmire]`).
- **Landing notices**: arriving somewhere shows how many checks are in logic there, and how many are locked.
- **Journal**: an **Archipelago** assignment listing Beacon Fragments collected / needed, coordinates found, squadmates, the Mako, Ilos, and every region with checks in logic.
- **Galaxy map**: "Archipelago: checks in logic" and "Archipelago: locked checks" callouts on 40 worlds.
- **Hints** about your items, or pointing at your checks, show on the HUD.

Keep the client running while you play: it keeps the journal and markers current. F7 can be rebound (see the setup guide).

**Updating:** replace the apworld, import and apply the new mod zip in ME3Tweaks Mod Manager, and run `install-bridge.ps1` again (this version needs bridge **v10**, included). From 0.1.x, start a new career.

**What to report:** whether F7 shows the summary (on foot, on the galaxy map, in the Mako); whether the journal has the Archipelago assignment and shows one fragment counter; whether galaxy-map callouts appear; whether shops show "Archipelago Item" entries. Please include your newest `ME1Client_*.txt` log from Archipelago's `logs` folder.

**New players:** download `ArchipelagoME1-0.2.1.zip` and follow the [setup guide](https://github.com/Unowa001/ArchipelagoME1/blob/main/worlds/mass_effect_le1/docs/setup_en.md). Requires Archipelago 0.6.8 or newer.
v0.2.1.title: 0.2.1 (beta test)

v0.2.2.description:
**Fixes the game hanging at the main menu in 0.2.1** (it froze right after "press any key"). The journal's Archipelago quest was stored in a format the game could not read. Everything else is the same as 0.2.1: the in-game tracker (F7, journal, galaxy-map markers), shop slots, and bridge v10.

**Updating from 0.2.1:** only the game mod changed. In ME3Tweaks Mod Manager, import and apply the new `ArchipelagoME1-mod.zip` (it is inside the zip you download). Replacing `mass_effect_le1.apworld` is optional (only its version number changed). The bridge is unchanged. Your 0.2.1 seeds and careers carry over.

**Updating from 0.2.0 or 0.1.x, or new players:** download `ArchipelagoME1-0.2.2.zip` and follow the [setup guide](https://github.com/Unowa001/ArchipelagoME1/blob/main/worlds/mass_effect_le1/docs/setup_en.md) (Updating section). From 0.1.x, start a new career.

Still to confirm in game: the journal's Archipelago assignment, galaxy-map callouts, F7, shop slots. Please report what you see, with your newest `ME1Client_*.txt` log.
v0.2.2.title: 0.2.2 (beta test)

v0.2.3.description:
**Beta test.** 📖 **[Setup guide](https://github.com/Unowa001/ArchipelagoME1/blob/main/worlds/mass_effect_le1/docs/setup_en.md)**

**Downloads:** `mass_effect_le1.apworld` (double-click to install), `ArchipelagoME1-mod-0.2.3.zip` (drag into ME3Tweaks Mod Manager, don't unzip), `ArchipelagoME1-bridge-0.2.3.zip` (unzip, run `install-bridge.ps1`), and the YAML template (optional).

Updating? Replace all three parts: the apworld, the mod zip and the bridge. This version needs **bridge v11**.

### New
- **Shop item names:** while the client is connected, each Archipelago shop slot shows the item it holds (for example "Link's Hookshot"). Its description says who the item is for and whether it is progression.
- **F7 summary box:** F7 now opens one message box with the whole summary (checks in logic per region, every uncharted planet with checks in logic, what each locked world needs). Close it with its button or F7.
- **Options Creator presets:** "Story Focus" (fewer checks) and "Completionist" (everything on).
- `/notices all | important | off` in the client controls the HUD notices. Notices are wrapped so the whole text shows.

### Fixed
- **Infinite sprint** left Shepard out of breath at once. Sprinting now never tires.
- **Galaxy-map markers** did not show. Each marker now gets its own slot in its system.

### Please report
Whether shop names show (also after switching tabs, sorting and buying), whether the F7 box shows line breaks and closes cleanly, and whether sprinting works in and out of combat. Logs: the newest `ME1Client_*.txt` in Archipelago's `logs` folder.

An existing 0.2.x career keeps working. Shops you already visited have no slots.
